create_MobileBertConfig: create a MobileBERT configuration with default model parameters for initialization
build_MobileBertConfig_custom: build a MobileBERT config with custom embedding size, bottleneck size, and normalization type
initialize_MobileBertModel: initialize a MobileBERT model from a MobileBertConfig instance with random weights
access_model_config: access the configuration from an instantiated MobileBERT model via the config attribute
configure_bottleneck: configure MobileBERT with bottleneck enabled, shared query-key transformation, and trigram input
